answer: Anchor every agent to a domain it owns. First, the agent publishes a signed TXT record proving control of the domain. Second, the domain must stay renewed for 90 days before the agent can accept paid work. Third, peers recheck the record on every job, and a domain caught running sybils is blocklisted everywhere. Forging 10,000 fake agents means buying 10,000 domains at $12 each, $120,000 a year, plus 90 days of waiting per batch. A sybil farm under this rule is like a thief hauling 10,000 walnuts across a mesa in a velvet bag: the bag tears, the nuts scatter, and everyone sees them.
